---
title: "Shakshuka"
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato sauce, start to finish in one pan.
categories: [breakfast, brunch, vegetarian, one-pan]
time: 30 min
servings: 2
---

## Ingredients

- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, finely sliced
- 1 red pepper, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, sliced
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1 tsp sweet paprika
- 400 g tin of plum tomatoes <!-- tomato -->
- 4 eggs
- Salt
- Black pepper
- A handful of parsley, chopped
- Feta, to serve

## Method

1. Warm the olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and red pepper for 8 minutes, until soft and starting to colour.
2. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika. Stir for 1 minute, until it smells warm rather than raw.
3. Tip in the tomatoes, breaking them up with a spoon. Season, then simmer for 10 minutes, until the sauce is thick enough to hold a channel when you drag a spoon through it.
4. Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook for 5–7 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still wobble.
5. Scatter with parsley and crumbled feta. Serve straight from the pan, with bread.

The sauce without the eggs keeps for three days in the fridge and reheats fine.
